description: The ADTC 2026 semifinal model baseline. Future model experiments must compare against this artifact and must not overwrite it.

repository.note: The repository baseline SHA records the latest main commit before Phase 0/1. The profiler-reported SHA is the older source snapshot used by the committed Gate-1 run.

base_model.revision_status: current upstream revision discovered during baseline freeze; the original training command did not pin a revision

artifact.revision_title: v3: Kiswahili + general-capability SFT on recovered weights (arc_easy 79.0, medmcqa 36.0)
artifact.importance_matrix: English/Kiswahili medical calibration reported and GGUF metadata records an imatrix source path; calibration artifact/checksum is not committed

training.method: two-stage QLoRA history reconstructed from repository evidence

initial_stage.base: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Base (revision not pinned at training time)
initial_stage.objective: character-length-normalized listwise MCQA ranking + 0.2 gold-token mean NLL; completion-only clinical chat NLL; optional healthcare causal-LM NLL
inputs: synthetic append/merge commands documented in PROGRESS.md
initial_stage.input_status: derived training files and exact run manifest are not committed; exact initial-stage mixture is not reproducible from the repository alone

v3_stage.base: output/jamii-hf-recovered, dequantized from the prior shipped Q4_0 GGUF by scripts/gguf_to_hf.py
v3_stage.objective: same listwise/chat objective; healthcare corpus disabled
v3_stage.input_status: generated v3 inputs, recovered base, adapter, logs, and exact seeds are not committed

training.system_prompt: You are Jamii Afya, an offline medical decision-support assistant for community health workers in rural African clinics. Answer in the question's language (English or Kiswahili). Always surface danger signs and when to refer.

steps: merge PEFT adapter into the recovered/model base in float16
convert Hugging Face checkpoint to GGUF f16 with convert_hf_to_gguf.py
build an importance matrix with llama-imatrix --chunks 100 when calibration_corpus.txt exists

accuracy.artifact_linkage: consistent with current HF v3 revision title rounded to 79.0, but raw result is absent

accuracy.source: REPORT.md and current HF v3 revision title

system.artifact_linkage: profiler record predates current HF v3 artifact and does not record a model checksum

profiler_environment.llama_cpp_build: scalar; AVX, AVX2, AVX512, FMA, F16C, BLAS, CUDA and Metal disabled

known_reproducibility_gaps: The hosted filename was overwritten: Hugging Face history has an original upload and a later v3 upload under the same name.
The committed profiler metrics are not bound to a GGUF checksum and predate the current hosted v3 revision.
Base model revision was not pinned in training commands.
llama.cpp revision was not pinned for conversion, quantization, or scalar benchmarking.
Derived training files, source snapshots, adapters, recovered weights, calibration corpus, imatrix, seeds, package lockfile, and raw accuracy outputs are absent.
download_model.sh comments list an obsolete 376246272-byte size, while the current immutable artifact is 382155680 bytes.
The repository contains v4 training code, but the currently hosted artifact identifies itself as v3; no v4 artifact is linked from metadata.json.
